newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Greek tanker run aground off Venezuela, no spill.
newsitem.headline: Greek tanker run aground off Venezuela, no spill.

text.p: The Greek tanker Olympic Sponsor, carrying 476,940 barrels of medium crude, ran aground in the outer navigation channel of Lake Maracaibo in northwestern Venezuela, a spokesman for state company Lagoven said Tuesday.
Port authorities were still trying to re-float the tanker, which was bound for Rotterdam, Tuesday afternoon, the spokesman said. The tanker ran aground at 1800 local/2400 GMT Monday, he added.
None of the ship's cargo had been spilled during the accident, the spokesman said.

The tanker had run into difficulties between buoys 20 and 22 of the navigation channel -- exactly the same place where the Greek-flagged Nissos Amorgos tanker ran aground Feb. 28 spilling at least 28,000 barrels of heavy crude.
The Olympic Sponsor had left Lagoven's La Salina port on the northeastern shore of Lake Maracaibo earlier Monday.
The Lagoven spokesman could not immediately say who the client for the tanker's crude was.
